marta: Heads-up — saw a short spike in duplicate session counts in the console for EU yesterday ~09:12UTC. Users reported streaming cut out then resumed. billing showed a small double-charge blip.
vikram: SSE or WS? proxy or client side?
marta: SSE via edge-proxy (eu-west1). Looks like affinity cookie churning — sessions get a new cookie id on reconnect.
chris: Pasting small log extract:```INFO 09:12:10 connection closed client=42. reconnecting... old-aff=aff_xyz789 new-aff=aff_abc123 resume_id=rid-4a2f```
marta: Cookie header shows `Set-Cookie: session_affinity=aff_abc123; Path=/; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=30` — TTL is 30s from LB.
vikram: 30s is rough. Our resume/token semantics expect resume_id to be authoritative but console + billing dedupe currently keys on `session_affinity`.
sam: yep — console aggregates by cookie because it maps to user session in the dashboard. When cookie rotates it increments active_sessions metric and shows two sessions.
chris: Two problems: (1) proxy LB rotates cookie aggressively, (2) metering treats new socket as new consumer. Both cause noise & double-billing.
vikram: Quick mitigation options: increase Max-Age on cookie, freeze cookie rotation during resume window, or prefer resume_id in metrics. Which is least-risky?
marta: Increasing TTL is invasive on LB config (infra ticket), freeze rotation requires LB change too. Changing metrics to use `resume_id` looks safest short-term.
sam: I can change console aggregation to prefer `resume_id` when present (fall back to cookie). That will reduce UI noise. Also add `affinity_source` tag so we can filter LB vs client churn.
chris: For billing/quota we should also debounce reconnects for counting: ignore new connections that present a valid `resume_id` within 10s sliding window. Prevents double-charge for quick reconnects.
vikram: Agree. Implementation notes: runtime should emit telemetry fields `resume_id`, `affinity_cookie`, `affinity_rotated` boolean. Console & billing pipelines switch to `resume_id` dedupe.
marta: Plan: (1) console change (sam) -> canary (2) runtime debounce+telemetry change (eng-runtime) -> canary (3) LB sticky TTL followup (infra). Can we canary EU 5%?
sam: I'll open console PR and enable a flag `ui.dedupe_by_resume_id` for canary.
chris: I'll draft runtime PR for debounce window + telemetry. Pseudocode:```if (resume_id && last_seen(resume_id) < 10000) { mark_metering('reconnect_debounce') } else { normal_metering() }```
vikram: Also add a small metric `session_affinity_rotations` so we can track LB churn separately.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/1234 (eu-west1, 5%) — auto-rollback policy enabled.
oncall-sre: Please add alert: `duplicate_session_spike` > 50% baseline for 5m -> page oncall with runbook link. Include dashboard widget linking to `resume_id` vs `affinity_cookie` counts.
marta: I'll link runbook + open infra ticket for LB TTL. Sam/chris thx — please tag me on PRs. :thumbsup:
sam: Will do. Filing console ticket now.
